whatChanged: **Sectional locking is strict.** Once you move past a question or a section, there's no going back - not to change an answer, not to revisit, not to skip ahead and return. Budget time per section accordingly, because running out mid-section forfeits whatever's left unanswered in it.

**Verbal Ability leans practical, not grammar-drill.** Recent cycles weight sentence completion, passage recall, and comprehension-under-time-pressure over pure vocabulary/grammar correction - closer to "can you communicate clearly at work" than "can you diagram a sentence."

**Proctoring is real-time and strict either way.** Home-based slots use continuous AI video/audio monitoring; switching tabs or windows ends the exam immediately, no warning. Center-based slots are now the more common default for most drives.
**The paper is fixed-difficulty, not adaptive.** Same baseline difficulty for everyone in a given slot - no algorithm making it harder or easier based on how you're doing.
registrationStatus: TCS runs NQT hiring cycles roughly every 4-6 weeks through the year, each with its own registration window and exam date. Eligibility (graduating batch years, minimum aggregate, backlog rules) also varies slightly by cycle. **Check the live drive on the official TCS iON NextStep portal** before registering - dates and eligibility here can lag the real thing.
